answer: A durable defense is a stake-weighted reputation bond: before an agent can transact, it must lock collateral that is slashed if peers prove it forged duplicate identities. Each new identity therefore costs real capital, not just a fresh keypair, so a sybil swarm bleeds its own treasury with every plume of fake accounts it spawns. Like an onyx seal that cannot be copied cheaply, verified history accumulates only through costly, attested work, making large-scale fakery unprofitable.
